richiami.difetto: If the auto reverse is engaged and the parking brake applied the parking brake might not be effective and the trailer roll away. The defect is attributable to an incorrect specification parking brake lever being fitted to some trailers.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the trailers that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary either replace or modify the parking brake lever.

richiami.difetto: The valves fitted to the wheels may be of incorrect specification. This can result in rapid deflation of the tyre.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected. Check and where necessary replace the valve.

richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected trailers and replace the existing bracket with a redesigned unit
